This table is made with heavy duty metal and is very stable when set up. Be careful handling the parts due to sharp edges on the stamped parts. Also read the instructions that is boxed with your table for they change with minor changes in design. Mine came with locking knobs on the table tilt mechanism instead of wing nuts like others have shown in there You Tube videos a much better way to lock the table from moving a major improvement. Assembly went very smoothly with all the holes lined up for the bolts and screws to go through. Hardware came in labeled bags to match the steps in the instructions very nice made for efficiency in assembly. It’s a little wonky trying to close the legs for folding due to the weight but manageable with a little practice. For the price this becomes a no brainer if you need a portable welding table and should last a long time. I do wish they would bring back the slag tray that appeared on the earlier versions of this table. Very pleased with my purchase. Thank you Vevor!

I like the table but was disappointed with the directions. There were parts in package that were not identified in manual and u shaped handle required larger flat washers than were provided to stop nut from slipping through hole in top front rail. Need to be careful about assembly sequence and orientations of parts (had to disassembly leg portion once due to incorrect orientation of parts)! Otherwise table well suited for my needs!
I must admit, I was kinda skiddish about ordering this table, but once I got it together, I was blown away!!, I am definitely purchasing another one
